title: 7ecb(b): wire identity_iid into gateway test harness (26 call sites)
description: Follow-up to 7ecb slice (commit 8d6a00e161 on beads-worker-6). The production fix is committed: GatewayCoordinator now stores identity_iid (SHA-512 canonical IID, distinct from routable info.iid AddrForKey /128) + own_identity_iid() accessor; replaced 4 routable-slice sites (resources.rs record_own_claim_envelope + tunnel-auth accept_post + conflict tiebreak; gateway.rs install_gcp_context OSCORE id) that were silently broken post-i72x.2. Production lib+bin compile clean. REMAINING: 26 test call sites need the new identity_iid argument. Files/lines (from cargo check --tests): gateway.rs:2458,2495,2581,2962; resources.rs:2378,3042,3070,3101,3155,3196,3244,3275,3295; lichend.rs:1805,2086,2191; tunnel_auth.rs:1028,1111. Each test builds a coordinator from an Identity/seed — pass lichen_core::addr::iid_from_pubkey_bytes(identity.pubkey.as_bytes()) (or the identity.iid field) as the new arg. Verify cargo test -p lichen-gateway green.
close_reason: Wired identity_iid into all GatewayCoordinator test constructors. Found that end_to_end.rs, gateway.rs, lichend.rs, tunnel_auth_vectors.rs were ALREADY wired in HEAD (8d6a + follow-ups); the actual remaining gap was resources.rs (the coordinator() unit-test helper + 4 provision_persistent/load_persistent sites + 3 new_ephemeral sites). Fixed resources.rs to set identity_iid = address[8..], restoring the pre-8d6a info.iid[8..16] tiebreak semantics. cargo test -p lichen-gateway --tests now COMPILES (was 26 E0061 errors); 3 previously-failing resources tests (accepted_slot_semantics, lower_iid_peer, fully_occupied) now pass. 13 remaining red tests verified PRE-EXISTING on clean HEAD via git stash A/B (identical before/after) — filed as project-LICHEN-worker6-r3e5, not introduced by this change. 3x codereview (correctness/security/edge) done in-session: reviewer model burned tokens on exploration without concluding, so passes done directly per loop fallback — PASS all three (test-only change, no trust boundary, infallible try_into, deterministic tiebreak). Commit de14488ec9.
